historical_source: OpenClaw Slime reward grouping and task-advantage code as it existed before an exclusion guard was introduced
helper_adaptation: The runtime Slime Sample import is replaced by a type-only fixture annotation. The grouping, reward selection, centering, sample-standard-deviation and expansion function bodies are identical.
replay_adaptation: The historical callback is reduced to the task-side call sequence. Synthetic sample records preserve the exclusion flags and grouping relationships. Downstream effective advantage is a diagnostic projection.
data: Six synthetic batches defined in the workspace. No external assets or production traces are present.
environment: Recorded on the platform mirror of the declared AutoRLBench Slime shared image. The full historical training run used a separate environment.
recorded_evidence_projection: Only observed-arm values, dependency versions and public fixture/source hashes are retained. The matching CPU control was used to verify the diagnosis before submission.
